title: Icarus: Re-Winged
description: Lots of new beautiful skins for wings!
body:
An unofficial add-on for the **Icarus** mod that revamps wing visuals and introduces new custom **animated** wing skins.
> The mod also includes crafts for all kinds of wings, so you can craft them on survival! (Starting from version **1.1.0**)
  
**Artist** [Link](https://dalink.to/polinatassel)

- Feathered Wings
  ![Feathered Wings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/61a218851d92fe2637000b4d3436716d2d1ed3a0.gif)
- Membrane (Leather) Wings
  ![Membrane Wings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/51aa36c7a2f01948add60d69a54a17ae71e9aecb.gif)
- Butterfly (Zanzas) Wings
  ![Zanzas Wings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9c879c0241c8a3107d23bf47b5fdec510f31920.gif)

## Required:
[Icarus](https://modrinth.com/mod/icarus)
